test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven people P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). S is sitting to the immediate left of Q. V is sitting third to the left of S. R is sitting third to the right of T. U is sitting second to the left of R. How many people are sitting between S and R when counted from the right of R?
solution:
**Given:** Seven people P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

1) S is sitting to the immediate left of Q.

2) V is sitting third to the left of S. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed525ff2e31a186bc19510350608ac9eb44bd62dc3e6d0951eb238e4f06e0418.png] 

3) U is sitting second to the left of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74f1fcfe77bb7db67875fc20e7986c7cca4bda15c4ea26e40373ced82ddbdb00.png] 

4) R is sitting third to the right of T.

After positioning T only, one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4dc822267614c550c445a0af6c8b4d3e2350162c9fbe25aa538a72061330595f.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement one person is sitting between S and R when counted from the right of R.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
